annotations.title: List cron runs in a window

description: List every run of a cron expression between start and end (both inclusive) in an IANA time zone, DST-aware, oldest first. Default limit 20, max 100; truncated is true when there are more. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/between.

end.description: Window end (inclusive). ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (2026-11-01T09:00:00Z), a local time read in the time zone (2026-11-01T09:00), or unix seconds.

expression.description: Cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5", "*/15 * * * *", "0 30 8 * * *" (6 fields = leading seconds) or "@daily".

start.description: Window start (inclusive). ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (2026-11-01T09:00:00Z), a local time read in the time zone (2026-11-01T09:00), or unix seconds.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the schedule runs in, e.g. "America/Denver", "Europe/London". Default UTC.

name: cron_runs_between

time.description: Local ISO 8601 time with UTC offset

title: List cron runs between two times
